description: This file contains unit tests for a command-line flag parsing library, including tests for flag aliasing, conflict detection, XML serialization, and parsing various flag types such as strings, integers, booleans, and vectors, using Google Test framework.

classes.name: Flag
classes.description: Represents a command-line flag with methods for aliasing, setting values, and XML serialization.

classes.name: FlagAlias
classes.description: Represents an alias for a command-line flag, including its mode and name.

classes.name: FlagAliasMode
classes.description: Enumeration of modes for flag aliases, such as exact match or consuming following arguments.

classes.name: VerbosityFlag
classes.description: A specialized flag for setting logging verbosity levels.

methods.name: flagXml
methods.description: Serializes a Flag object into an XML representation, returning a map of attribute names to values.

methods.name: ConsumeFlags
methods.description: Parses a list of command-line arguments, consuming recognized flags and updating their values.

methods.name: ConsumeFlagsConstrained
methods.description: Parses flags with constrained values, such as repeated flags, and updates arguments accordingly.

methods.name: InvalidFlagGuard
methods.description: Creates a flag guard that rejects positional arguments and flags.

methods.name: UnexpectedArgumentGuard
methods.description: Creates a flag guard that rejects positional arguments and flags, used for strict argument parsing.
